h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Karnal

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Karnal

c: Karnal sits on the old Grand Trunk Road and is home to agricultural and dairy research institutes, so campus grounds make up much of its open space. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to institute campuses, schools, colleges, housing colonies and parks in Karnal. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,220 km away, and travel to Haryana by road.

Research campuses have staff quarters, hostels and visitors, so the gym should serve several groups. Haryana has hot summers and cold winters, with fog on many January mornings. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats are made for that range. The machines are fixed by our team or a dealer in north India, on grouted or self-standing bases. Tell us who will use the gym most and send photos of the ground for a layout drawing.

items.q: Which machines suit an institute campus?
items.a: A mix of gentle machines for staff and visitors, such as pendulums and walkers, plus strength stations for students. Combination machines save space on a shared ground.

items.q: Can the machines be used through a Haryana winter?
items.a: Yes. The frames and seats are made for outdoor use in heat and cold. Place the gym where it gets morning sun, and check moving parts at the change of season.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms in Karnal?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment from Vasai by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India, as per the approved layout drawing.
